transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Hello — do you have any questions about your cataract surgery or recovery?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, I do have a few questions. When can I start doing a little bit of gardening?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
You can go back to light exercise after 1 week, and that includes gardening. Just avoid heavy or strenuous work for a month.

Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Great, thank you for that information. I also wanted to ask, when can I start using my eye gel for dry eyes?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
If you were using eye drops before your operation, such as for dry eyes, it’s safe to continue using them unless you’ve been told otherwise.

Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: That's helpful, thank you. I'm experiencing a very high sensitivity to bright light. Is that normal?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
Some sensitivity to light can be normal while your eyes adjust to the new lenses. If it’s just mild and things seem brighter than usual, wearing sunglasses outside can help.

But significant pain with bright light, or severe light sensitivity, is not normal, especially if the eye is red and painful, and we may need to assess this further.

Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Thanks for explaining that. One last thing, should I still have some blurriness by now?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
It’s common for vision not to be completely clear in the first week after your operation. It should improve quickly and settle down over time.

If your vision is still blurry, or getting significantly worse, we may need to check it to make sure it’s okay.

Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: No, that's all the questions I had. Thank you so much for your help.

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, all my questions have been answered. Thank you again!

verdict.label: pass
